title: EdgeScope report snapshot
description: Shape of data/latest-report.json, the machine-readable output of `npm run report`. This is a point-in-time snapshot, not a live feed — check `generatedAt` before trusting a consumer's cached copy.

version.description: Snapshot schema version. Consumers should reject snapshots with an unrecognized version rather than guess at field meaning.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this snapshot was generated. This is a snapshot, not a live value.

marketId.description: On-chain market id, as a hex string.

currentPrice.description: Median independent price used for this observation. See priceSources/priceSourceQuality for how many sources actually backed it.

priceSources.description: Names of the price sources that actually returned a usable price for this observation.

realizedVolAnnual.description: Annualized realized volatility used for the naive baseline. null means the fixed disclosed assumption was used instead (realized-vol fetch unavailable).

dreamdexUp.description: DreamDEX's own implied probability from the order book. null when liquidity was insufficient to trust a probability.

naiveEst.description: Baseline probability from the analytic model (time-scaled normal CDF over the observed move).

llmEst.description: Probability from the Somnia LLM Inference Agent.

ensembleEst.description: Average of naiveEst and llmEst. Not claimed to be independent of naiveEst — see docs/METHODOLOGY.md.

issue.description: Present when this market was skipped or invalidated; human-readable reason.

thinking.description: LLM Agent reasoning text, or null if unavailable.
